title: A replacement deadline, year by year
heading: A Tighter LP Bound Means a Smaller Search
cases: a replacement inside the deadline is allowed, and one after it is refused
a replacement starting in the deadline year itself is allowed
a replacement one year past the deadline is refused
a bypass with no replacement at all is refused
a replacement before its bypass, or without one, is refused
a bypass started so late that no replacement year is left is refused
on a small LP the year-by-year rows give a lower bound than the colleague's rows
